headline: You can now close the loop on a prospect: say "[Name] is now a client" and Command Room converts them — flips the relationship, links the engagement, and offers to set up the project. Previously this was offered but never actually did anything.

items.prompt_template: New command: when a prospect becomes a paying client, just say "[Name] is now a client" (or "promote [Name] to client"). I'll flip them from prospect to client, link the engagement to your company, and offer to set up their project folder — reusing the existing record, no duplicate. This used to be offered but never worked; now it does. If any of your current prospects have already signed, you can convert them now.
